'''Arleil Schous''' was an aging [[Defel]] [[Treasure hunting|fortune hunter]] who spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]]. He was drinking in the [[cantina]] when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk]] sought the [[astromech droid]] [[261]] at the establishment and again later in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] when the [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the building.

On the latter occasion, he sat with the patrons [[Hem Dazon]], [[Bom Vimdin]], [[Pons Limbic]], and [[Braconnor Bakiska]] in one of the backrooms before moving to share a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold]] with the patrons [[Ketwol]] and [[Kardue'sai'Malloc]]. Due to his age, Schous was losing the ability to bend light around his body and virtually disappear.

==Biography==
[[File:Schous-BH.png|thumb|right|250px|Arleil Schous drank in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]
Arleil Schous was a [[Defel]] [[Treasure hunting|fortune hunter]] who spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> in [[1 BBY]]. During that time,<ref name="Date note">{{BountyHuntDate}}</ref> he<ref name="AEYNTK" /> was having drinks with a [[Trandoshan]] at a table near the establishment's entrance when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk]] asked after the rogue [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[astromech droid]] [[261]] at the [[cantina]].<ref name="BountyHunt">''[[Bounty Hunt]]''</ref>

In 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the [[Secret mission to Tatooine]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Schous was sat at a table<ref name="AEYNTK" /> in one of the cantina's backrooms<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> with the [[Arcona]] [[Hem Dazon]], the [[Advozse]] [[Bom Vimdin]], the [[Siniteen]] [[Pons Limbic]], and the [[Stennes Shifter]] [[Braconnor Bakiska]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> when the [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the establishment seeking a [[pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:SchousTable-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Schous sat with Hem Dazon, Bom Vimdin, Pons Limbic, and Braconnor Bakiska.]]
Schous soon moved<ref name="ANH" /> to a table nearer the cantina's entrance to meet with the [[Pacithhip]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Ketwol]]<ref name="Topps">{{SWCT|set=Alien Underground|cardname=Ketwol}}</ref> and the [[Devaronian]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Kardue'sai'Malloc]]<ref name="Labria">{{ForceCollection|Kardue'sai'Malloc|star=2}}</ref> over a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold]].<ref name="CL" /> The [[Lamproid]] [[Dice Ibegon]]<ref name="Ibegon">{{ForceCollection|Dice Ibegon|star=1}}</ref> was also seated with the trio by the time Skywalker was thrown into the table next to them during an altercation with the criminals [[Ponda Baba]] and [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]], whom Kenobi then subdued.<ref name="CL" />

==Personality and traits==
By 1 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> Schous was getting old and slowly losing the ability to bend light around his body and virtually disappear,<ref name="AEYNTK" /> a trait of the Defel [[species]].<ref name="Obi-Wan">[[Obi-Wan 2|''Obi-Wan'' 2]]</ref> The Defel had [[Color|brown]] [[Hair|fur]], brown skin, and red [[eye]]s.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While at the cantina, Schous wore a tan [[jacket]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SchousMask-Chronicles.png|thumb|right|250px|Rick Baker created the mask for Arleil Schous.]]
Arleil Schous first appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH" /> which was released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> He was portayed by [[Kim Falkinburg]]<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref> and added to the film during a series of supplemental shots filmed for the cantina sequence on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]]–[[January 25|25]], 1977.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Arleil Schous' mask was created by creature designer [[Rick Baker]], who made it from a commercial werewolf Halloween mask he had designed. An unaltered version of the mask was used for the character<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=d1AAd1tsPds|text=Star Wars: A New Hope – Cantina Archeology Part 2: Behind The Scenes of the Mos Eisley Cantina – US|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> [[Lak Sivrak]],<ref name="Sivrak">{{ForceCollection|Lak Sivrak|star=1}}</ref> but for Schous, Baker chopped the mask's face up, added ears, and fabricated it with glowing eyeballs.<ref name="YouTube" />

The mask was originally made for "The Thing in the Attic," a Halloween show put on by [[Wikipedia:Bob Burns III|Bob Burns]]<ref name="YouTube" /> in [[1974]]. During the show, Baker wore the mask and portrayed a demon summoned by a possessed girl inspired by [[Wikipedia:The Exorcist|''The Exorcist'']].<ref name="CantinaBlog">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-9-things-you-might-not-know-about-the-aliens-of-star-wars-a-new-hope|text=''Star Wars'' at 40 | Much to Learn You Still Have: 9 Things You Might Not Know About the Aliens of ''Star Wars: A New Hope''}}</ref> Due to time and budget restraints,<ref name="Insider71">{{InsiderCite|71|Ask Lobot}}</ref> the mask was then recycled for use in ''[[Star Wars]]'',<ref name="CantinaBlog" /> where the character became known as "Bat-Demon Guy,"<ref name="YouTube" /> "Wolfe,"<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> or "Wolfman" during production. In the film's original release, Schous was visible in a second shot in the cantina, but director [[George Lucas]] had long been bothered by the character's off-the-shelf mask,<ref name="CantinaRollCall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> as although he had approved its use, the mask had been created outside his sphere of control.<ref name="Insider71" /> Because of this, the second shot was replaced in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of the film with a close-up of the character [[Melas]] instead.<ref name="Melas">{{DB|character|melas|Melas}}</ref>

[[File:ItCameFromTheAttic.png|thumb|left|300px|The bat-demon guy mask was used in Bob Burns' "The Thing in the Attic" Halloween Special.]]
In the current ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], Schous was first identified by the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK Original">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1998]] "[[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]" for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' produced by [[Decipher]], Inc..<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Official Tournament Sealed Deck|cardname=Arleil Schous}}</ref> In Legends, Defels' ability to bend light around themselves was based on the fact that Schous was hidden in shadow during his appearances in the film; however, as various well-lit imagery of the Defel was used, Decipher eventually explained the discrepancy by establishing that he was slowly losing the ability due to his age.<ref name="CantinaRollCall" />
